</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify the specific dates for automatic backups to be performed each week. Format: Enter a number between 0 and 6 to represent Sunday through Saturday (e.g., 1 represents Monday). Separate multiple dates with commas (,). Example: Entering 1,3,5 means the system will perform backups on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays every week. Default: If not set, the default is a full cycle (0,1,2,3,4,5,6), meaning backups will be performed daily.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_alarmwaterlevel_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Sets the alarm threshold for backup dataset storage space usage. Unit: %. Default value: 100. Value range: [50, 300].</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_backupfrequency_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_backupfrequency_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Backup<wbr>Frequency</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify the daily automatic backup frequency. 12: Back up twice a day, approximately 12 hours apart; 24: Back up once a day (default), approximately 24 hours apart.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_backupmethod_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_backupmethod_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Backup<wbr>Method</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Set automatic backup method. Valid values:</p>
<ul>
<li>0: Logical backup;</li>
<li>1: Physical backup;</li>
<li>3: Snapshot backup (supported only in cloud disk version).</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_backupretentionperiod_go">

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>

        <span id="state_backuptime_go">

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_backupversion_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify the specific backup dates to be retained long-term. This setting only takes effect when LongTermUnit is set to weekly or monthly. Weekly Retention: Enter a number between 0 and 6 to represent Sunday through Saturday. Separate multiple dates with commas. Monthly Retention: Enter a number between 1 and 31 to represent specific dates within the month. Separate multiple dates with commas.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>

        <span id="state_longtermunit_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Long-term retention period. Supports selecting specific dates for backups on a weekly or monthly basis (e.g., backup data for the 1st and 15th of each month) to retain for a longer period. Disabled (default): Long-term retention is disabled. Weekly retention: Specify <code>weekly</code>. Monthly retention: Specify <code>monthly</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_notify_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>

<ul>
<li>true: Send.</li>
<li>false: Do not send.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_oplogexpireddays_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_oplogexpireddays_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Oplog<wbr>Expired<wbr>Days</a>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>

</pulumi-choosable>

## Import



mongodb instance backup rule can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Mongodb/instanceBackupRule:InstanceBackupRule example cmgo-rnht8d3d
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
